messages:
Jules R: hi team, day 1 done but running into a few provisioning snags. trying to register a YubiKey for Okta MFA and it keeps failing with 'U2F device not found'. i also accepted the Google Drive invite but clicking 'Shared drives' shows 'You don't have access'. 1Password invite didn't land either. anyone point me to the right person?
Tara (People Ops): welcome Jules!! tagging IT. @Keeley (IT) can you pick this up? also @Jules R remind me which email you used in the invite? sometimes the alias issues crop up. :wave:
Jules R: invited with jules.r@redwood.ai (that's the one on my badge). i did get the Slack invite and can post here. using a personal yubikey for now plugged into a Win11 laptop (company image).
Keeley (IT): hey @Jules R — sorry for the friction. two quick checks: 1) open a browser in admin mode and visit our Okta enroll page (https://okta.redwood.ai/signin/enroll) and try the hardware token flow. 2) for Drive, confirm you clicked the link that went to the corporate domain (redwood.ai) not the old company alias (redwoodhq.com).
Jules R: i only see a 404 on the enroll page when not elevated. opening as admin now.
Keeley (IT): ok — if enroll still errors, run this in PowerShell and paste the output so I can map your device to our AD record:
```
whoami /user
```
Jules R: output: SID S-1-5-21-262...-1001 (shortened)
Keeley (IT): thanks. I see your account in AD but there's an unresolved alias mapping to redwoodhq.com that blocked Drive group sync and 1Password SSO. i'll kick a sync and guide you through hardware token verify. can you plug the key in and go to the enroll flow again?
Jules R: re-trying now. browser prompts for touch, i touch it and... error still: 'U2F device not found'
Keeley (IT): hm — are you on USB-A -> USB-C adapter? some cheap adapters break the U2F CTAP path. if so try the other USB port or plug directly. also try Edge or Chromium-based browser in case of driver quirks.
Jules R: switching ports + using Edge, ok now it asked to register and completed!
Access-Bot: 1Password enterprise invite queued to jules.r@redwood.ai (sent).
Jules R: got 1Password invite and can log in via SSO. Drive still shows no access for Shared drives though.
Keeley (IT): syncing group memberships now. i saw you were added to the Eng Onboarding group but the alias mismatch prevented google sync. running a manual push. should take a minute.
IT-Bot: directory sync job started (job id: ds-1936001234-1).
Raj P: hey @Jules R — when Drive is ready, can you confirm access to eng/onboarding and the 'team-repos' folder? added a readme there with repo links.
Jules R: will check as soon as sync finishes. thanks Raj.
IT-Bot: directory sync job completed: success.
Keeley (IT): ok you should now see 'Shared drives > Redwood > Eng' and the folders. refresh the Drive web app and let me know.
Jules R: confirmed! i can see eng/onboarding and team-repos. yubikey works for Okta, 1Password SSO is live, Drive is populated. thanks for the fast turnaround. :tada:
Tara (People Ops): lovely! adding you to the buddy pool — ping if you want a quick walkthrough of the onboarding checklist.
Keeley (IT): note for the team: if yubikey fails on Win images, try a direct USB port and Chromium; aliases in cloud identity can block group syncs — escalate to infra if automated sync doesn't clear in 10 minutes. i'm leaving a short playbook in #it-setup.
IT-Bot: incident record created: IT-1936001234 - new hire alias + YubiKey enrollment (resolved).
